name: DepthPlayer
summary:
Turn your everyday 2D videos and photos into immersive 3D - converted in real time, entirely on your Meta Quest. No PC, no cloud, no uploads: everything runs on your headset, and your media stays on your device and your own network. No account, no ads, no tracking.
